notes.title: Eleanor in Miami
notes.content:
Dear PLEDGE players, have you got a chance to meet Eleanor?

Eleanor Robinson married her husband Drake for the simple idea of not being able to lift a single finger and live the good life. She barely cooks, she detests cleaning and the idea of her getting a job if laughable. She enjoys her days sleeping in while her husband goes off to work and while he grinds from nine to five she spends her days shopping and down at the hairdressers. To put it simply, Eleanor enjoys her life as a run-of-the-mill trophy wife.

ELEANOR 3

We’ve released ELEANOR 3 on STEAM in 2019 it was one of our first games released on this platform. Despite its flaws (being grindy, kind of not forgiving mistakes and with gameplay limited to 30 days) it had many fans.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116340/Eleanor_3/?curator_clanid=35434564

ELEANOR IN MIAMI

Now, in 2024, last Friday, we’ve released the next chapter of Eleanor’s adventures - ELEANOR IN MIAMI. So far, we got 93% of POSITIVE reviews, and we believe it’s a worthy successor of the previous hit. The game was released as EARLY ACCESS product, and despite the fact we may call it complete (6 endings), we promise to update it with a new content for a long period of time.
